# Merge-7B

This model is a merge of Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, produced with mergekit.
We also mixed in weights from Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B to improve Chinese ability.

## Usage

Load it like any other causal LM.

# bloom-finetune

This model was fine-tuned from bigscience/bloom-7b1 on an internal instruction set.
It keeps the original OpenRAIL license.

## Training

3 epochs, batch size 32.

# Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (unsloth)

This model was fine-tuned from meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on a small instruction set.

It keeps the original license.

# LoRA adapter

A LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B trained on internal data.
Merge it with peft before use.
